5565.title: Dynamic instruction clipping lacks diagnostics
5565.rootCauseOneLine: The shared agent configuration normalizer slices oversized instructions successfully without emitting a diagnostic, so both server and test harness lose the overflow signal.
5565.proposedFix: Preserve documented truncation and emit a length-only warning through the plugin logger and supported test harness whenever nonblank dynamic instructions are shortened.
5565.caveats: Repeated by the same agent in two clean trusted-base checkouts; no desktop or real-provider session was used. Candidate PR #5568 was withdrawn: the mandatory SDK version bump makes a complete fix exceed the autopilot five-file limit.
